capabilities: Bind a single vault folder to your Apple Notes account
Pull remote changes and push local edits via commands, ribbon, or status bar
Schedule automatic pull-then-push syncs on a fixed interval
Sign in to an Apple ID through Apple's browser pages and reauthenticate when needed
Locate the icloud-md binary and configure PATH entries for spawning it
extras: README carries a prominent warning that this is an unofficial Apple integration with real data-loss risk (it reverse-engineers CloudKit), recommends version-controlling the synced folder, notes desktop-only support, that sign-in needs a one-off ~150 MB Chromium download, and that the account likely needs Advanced Data Protection disabled. The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a folder of notes in sync with an Apple Notes account, particularly from Linux or Windows.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a thin Obsidian front-end for the icloud-md CLI

requires.name: Node.js 20+ and the icloud-md CLI on PATH

summary: Syncs one vault folder bidirectionally with Apple Notes by wrapping the icloud-md CLI, on any desktop OS.
